read: url -> page text in a chars window from offset; result has next_offset/has_more, …

tools.name: credential_login
tools.description: Signs in to a website with the person's saved logins; you never see a credential value. Path: open the sign-in page with cloud_browser, then auto. If auto canno…

host.description: list: exact host, e.g. "github.com"; matches saved logins allowing that host.

query.description: list: case-insensitive match on a saved login's name, definition key or hosts.

steps.description: attempt: multi-screen flow, each {fields: [declared selectors], submit, wait_for}. Exactly one of steps or submit.

where.description: report (required): where it appeared, never the value.

action.description: auto: sign in with the saved login matching the page; try first. discover: the saved login's field names for this page. attempt: one complete explicit fill and …

expect.description: auto, attempt, authenticator: outcome check {success_url_prefix, success_selector, failure_selector, challenge_selector, timeout_ms}.

fields.description: attempt (required): [{selector, field_key | literal, clear_first}], at least one field_key naming a Vault field; literal only for non-secret values. capture (re…

submit.description: attempt, authenticator (required): {kind: click|press_enter|none, selector}. propose_recipe: the submit shape that worked.

verbose.description: list: full records (allowed URLs, match mode, field names) instead of summary lines.

field_map.description: propose_recipe (required): the selectors that worked, [{selector, field_key, literal_key, step}].

session_id.description: Cloud Browser session. Required on the server for every action except list and report; omit in Matrx Extend (it uses its assigned tab).

description.description: report: extra detail. capture: plain-language description of the account.

display_name.description: capture (required): name for the new saved login.

code_selector.description: authenticator (required): selector of the one-time-code input.

failure_signals.description: propose_recipe: same shape; what a wrong password shows.

submit_selector.description: capture, propose_recipe: selector of the submit control.

success_signals.description: propose_recipe: [{kind, value, direction, label, weight}] proving sign-in succeeded.

challenge_signals.description: propose_recipe: same shape; what a verification or 2FA challenge looks like.

credential_item_id.description: auto, discover, attempt: a specific saved login; omit to match on the page URL. authenticator (required): the same saved login that just signed in.
